question: Should maintainers wait for this external fork to be rebased and proven, or open a credited current-main replacement for `/hooks/agent` accountId preservation?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the current branch is uneditable by maintainers, stale against the current delivery-policy seam, and missing real behavior proof for account-scoped delivery.

options.title: Port Or Replace On Current Main
options.body: Refresh this branch or open a credited replacement that applies the accountId fix to the current hook request handler and SourceDeliveryPlan seams before merge.

options.title: Wait For Contributor Refresh
options.body: The contributor can rebase the fork, enable maintainer edits, remove the changelog edit, update docs, and add real behavior proof before reassessment.

options.title: Close After Viable Replacement Lands
options.body: If a proof-positive replacement PR becomes the safe landing path, close this stale external branch as superseded after that replacement exists or lands.

recommendation.title: Port Or Replace On Current Main
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch or open a credited replacement that applies the accountId fix to the current hook request handler and SourceDeliveryPlan seams before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current main blame for the hook and SourceDeliveryPlan seams points to vincentkoc, and the PR author also requested review from this area owner.
